table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	itemname= case item.printable WHEN 1 THEN item.name ELSE 'Counter Sale:'+LTRIM(RTRIM(item.customicode)) END,   
	aliasname=item.customicode,   
	packingdesc=item.packingdesc,   
	accname = dbo.accounts.name,
	address = dbo.customer.address1,   
	address2= ISNULL(dbo.customer.address2, '') + CASE WHEN dbo.customer.phone is null THEN '' ELSE ' Phone : ' + ISNULL(dbo.customer.phone,'') END,   
	city= dbo.customer.city,    
	crlimit=customer.crlimit, 
	licenceno= dbo.customer.licenceno,   
	username= dbo.users.username,   
	saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	headerno = dbo.saleledger.headerno,   
	headerinvno = dbo.saleledger.headerinvno,
	date = Case :ai_printdate When 1 Then dbo.saleledger.originaldate When 2 Then dbo.saleledger.date When 3 Then dbo.saleledger.Billingdate  End, 
	invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
	misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	flatdisc = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	invsalestax = dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
	icode = saledetail.icode,   
	looseqty = SUM(saledetail.looseqty),
	bonusqty = SUM(saledetail.bonusqty),   
	packqty = SUM(saledetail.packqty),   
	packunits= saledetail.packunits,   
	saleprice= saledetail.saleprice,   
	discperc = saledetail.discperc,   
	salestax = saledetail.salestax,  
	itemflatdisc=saledetail.itemflatdisc,   
	posted=saleledger.posted,   
	balance=0,   
	unitsalestax = saledetail.unitsalestax,   
	gstperc = saledetail.gstperc,   
	invgstperc = saleledger.invgstperc1,   
	custTaxRegno=customer.salestaxregno  ,
	dbo.saleledger.custrefno,	
	dbo.saleledger.remarks,
	dbo.saleledger.printwaranty,
	dbo.saleledger.printbatch,
	AlterSaleInvCode=dbo.saleledger.AlterSaleInvCode,
	salesman=ltrim(rtrim(dbo.salesman.name)),
	Message=ltrim(rtrim(dbo.Message.description)),
	CUSTALIAS=ACCOUNTS.ALIASNAME
FROM 
	saleledger
	LEFT OUTER JOIN DBO.SalesMan ON (dbo.saleledger.smancode = dbo.salesman.salesmancode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN DBO.Message ON (dbo.saleledger.messagecode = dbo.message.messagecode),
	saledetail,   
	accounts,   
	customer,   
	users,   
	item  
WHERE 
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode between :ar_SInvCode and :ar_linvcode ) AND  
	( dbo.saleledger.custcode IN (:ar_custcode) )AND 
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode) AND 
	( dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
	( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
	( dbo.saleledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND  
	( dbo.saledetail.icode = dbo.item.icode)    
GROUP BY
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.headerno,   
	dbo.saleledger.headerinvno,
	dbo.saleledger.date, 
	dbo.saleledger.Originaldate, 
	dbo.saleledger.Billingdate, 
	dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
	dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
	dbo.saleledger.custrefno,	
	dbo.saleledger.remarks,
	dbo.saleledger.printwaranty,
	dbo.saleledger.printbatch,
	dbo.saleledger.AlterSaleInvCode,
	dbo.saleledger.posted,   
	dbo.saleledger.invgstperc1,   
	dbo.customer.salestaxregno  ,
	dbo.Accounts.AliasName,
	dbo.accounts.name, 
	dbo.customer.address1,   
	dbo.customer.address2, 
	dbo.customer.phone,   
	dbo.customer.city,    
	dbo.customer.crlimit,
	dbo.customer.licenceno,   
	dbo.users.username,   
	dbo.salesman.name,
	dbo.Message.description,
	dbo.item.customicode,   
	dbo.item.name,
	dbo.item.packingdesc,   
	dbo.item.Printable,
	dbo.saledetail.icode,   
	dbo.saledetail.packunits,
	dbo.saledetail.saleprice,   
	dbo.saledetail.discperc,   
	dbo.saledetail.salestax,  
	dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc,   
	dbo.saledetail.unitsalestax,   
	dbo.saledetail.gstperc
ORDER BY 
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,
	dbo.item.name

objects.name: c_discvalue
objects.visible: 1	if((looseqty * itemflatdisc)  + Round( looseqty * (saleprice - itemflatdisc ) *  ( discperc *  .01 ) , 2)=0,0,1)

objects.name: c_totaltax
objects.expression: Round(Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) ,2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2) + sum(c_salestaxval for all) , 0)

objects.name: c_sumsalestaxval
objects.visible: 1	if (sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for group 1) > 0, 1, 0)
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for group 1)

objects.name: c_invsalestaxval
objects.expression: Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01),2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2)

objects.name: c_grosstotal
objects.expression: Sum((  looseqty   *  (saleprice  - itemflatdisc) )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty )  for group 1)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: /*Round ( Sum((  looseqty   *  saleprice  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) ) *  ( 1 -  invdiscperc  * .01 )  -  flatdisc  +  misccharges  +  invsalestax , 0)*/Round(Sum (  c_netamount for group 1) -  flatdisc  + misccharges  + salestax , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for group 1 ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - discperc * 0.01) , 2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0)

objects.name: compute_11
objects.visible: 1	if(sum((looseqty * itemflatdisc)  + Round( looseqty * (saleprice - itemflatdisc ) *  ( discperc *  .01 ) , 2) for group 1)=0,0,1)
objects.expression: sum((looseqty * itemflatdisc)  + Round( looseqty * (saleprice - itemflatdisc ) *  ( discperc *  .01 ) , 2) for group 1)
